messages:
anika: Heads-up on modal list: when we switch to compact tokens the modal close button overlaps the toast on small screens. Attached gif.

peter: Repro: open modal at 360px, trigger save, toast slides up from bottom and sits over close X for ~400ms.

sam: Could we attach toasts to the modal container when modal is open? So they appear inside modal at top-right instead of viewport bottom.

tess: That feels odd for global messages. Maybe rule: toasts anchored to parent when parent has role=dialog. Else bottom. That keeps global toasts outside but modal-scoped messages inside.

anika: Another issue: the modal action buttons use primary/secondary weight; on compact spacing primary becomes too dominant. Suggest swapping to ghost primary in compact mode and keep emphasis on destructive actions when present.

sam: A11y: ensure modal close maintains DOM order and focus trap isn't lost when toast appears. If toast is focusable (links) it should not be tabbable in modal context. Use inert on non-modal parts.

peter: CSS sketch:
```css
.modal .toast { position: absolute; top: var(--space-2); right: var(--space-2); }
.modal.compact .primary { background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; }
```

tess: Copy nit: toast copy for save should be specific: instead of "Saved", use "Settings saved" when in settings modal. Keep message to 2 words.

anika: Acceptance criteria: 1) toast appears inside modal when dialog open, 2) no overlap with close X, 3) compact primary uses ghost style, 4) focus trap unaffected by toast.

sam: I'll add a PR with feature flag modal-scoped-toasts. Also add test for keyboard navigation with screen reader.

design-bot: Reminder: file Figma frames under component modal > compact tokens.

anika: Thanks folks. I'll add visual examples and preferred copy "Settings saved". Marking as in-progress.
